tools.description: Registrant emails still waiting for ICANN verification on this organization's domains, with the deadline. A domain whose registrant misses it stops resolving.

tools.description: Whether this organization has its registrant on file, and its details. The customer is the legal holder of every domain; save_registrant sets it and accepts the registration terms for the person you act for, before the first registration or transfer.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "manage_api_keys" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "manage_api_keys" appears informational but accepts parameters (environment) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: action, id, name, scopes, expires_in_days, domain_allowlist, ip_allowlist, environment

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_order, list_dns_presets, list_domain_services, list_unverified_contacts, check_domain, domain_page, save_registrant, manage_members · Private data: nymwell_status, list_dns_records, list_audit_events, stage_dns_change, search_domains, screen_domains, domain_info, purchase_domain, get_order, apply_dns_preset, get_domain, set_nameservers, set_contacts, list_domain_services, list_unverified_contacts, get_registrant, resend_contact_verification, apply_dns_to_domains, undo_dns_apply, dns_templates, dns_zone_file, set_record_note, save_registrant, manage_api_keys, contact_support · Public sink: screen_domains, list_dns_presets, set_contacts, list_domain_services, change_domain_service, resend_contact_verification, submit_transfer, check_domain, managed_domain_plan, save_registrant, manage_members, contact_support · Destructive: stage_dns_change, search_domains, change_domain_service, dns_templates, set_domain_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_order, list_dns_presets, list_domain_services, list_unverified_contacts, check_domain, domain_page, save_registrant, manage_members · Private data: nymwell_status, list_dns_records, list_audit_events, stage_dns_change, search_domains, screen_domains, domain_info, purchase_domain, get_order, apply_dns_preset, get_domain, set_nameservers, set_contacts, list_domain_services, list_unverified_contacts, get_registrant, resend_contact_verification, apply_dns_to_domains, undo_dns_apply, dns_templates, dns_zone_file, set_record_note, save_registrant, manage_api_keys, contact_support · Public sink: screen_domains, list_dns_presets, set_contacts, list_domain_services, change_domain_service, resend_contact_verification, submit_transfer, check_domain, managed_domain_plan, save_registrant, manage_members, contact_support · Destructive: stage_dns_change, search_domains, change_domain_service, dns_templates, set_domain_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
